text:
Maria Chen: Proposal: split SIEM export access into two roles: `triage_view` (masked, short TTL) and `forensics_read` (JIT, unmasked). Current `siem_read` too broad.

Aj Patel: +1. JIT flow? ticket + approver + default 8h TTL? :thinking_face:

Maria Chen: yes. secops approver, default 8h extendable with manager. enforce KMS unwrap audit and weekly proxy-key rotation.

Devon Ruiz: add signed unwrap attestation in audit stream so we can prove who unwrapped key. security-bot can stamp events.

security-bot: Policy draft saved: SIEM_UNWRAP must emit audit_event {id, requester, approver, cmk_alias, ticket}.

Samir: exporter currently uses broad iam:Decrypt. Plan: move to Vault-wrapped short-lived tokens returned to pods, no long-lived decrypt perms. snippet pls.

Maria Chen: short snippet in RFC; basic flow: pod -> Vault /siem/wrap(role, ttl) -> wrapped_blob -> KMS decrypt -> session token.

Ana (oncall): reminder: INC-2025 blocked forensic access due to key rotation. we need fallback CMK alias/siem-fallback and alerting.

Devon Ruiz: fallback attempt + PagerDuty alert + create a 2-approver short-lived admin token if both fails. exporter should queue encrypted events up to 1h.

Aj Patel: redaction: triage_view must be policy-driven (ruleset v1.2) not fragile regex. forensics_read bypasses redaction but has 3y retention and stricter tenancy.

Maria Chen: rollout plan: phase1 create roles (no enforcement), phase2 enforce for new grants, phase3 revoke legacy `siem_read`. migration script to map old grants by last-use + justify, auto-create tickets for owners >90d.

Samir: I'll review KMS+Vault flow.

Devon Ruiz: I'll own audit schema + SIEM mapping.

Aj Patel: I'll own RBAC rollout and migration script.

security-bot: Reminder: schedule review meeting with sec-arch + infra Monday 10:00 UTC.

Maria Chen: Will open RFC and INC/TICKET templates and post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
